scope: Offline saved-state/metric reproduction of unchanged frozen uncertainty outputs; no resimulation or acceptance-criterion changes
identity_checks: Exact source/archive/protocol/code/input/trace/XML/fileSHA,scenarioIDs/counts,sharedseeds,parametercontexts; all booleans/counts exact. Strict finiteJSON.
metric_recomputation: Recompute endpoint and common-time dt discrepancies from actual saved main/half traces; compare bitwise/equality first and fixed roundoff diagnostic separately.
force_replay: Optional same-model evaluation on restored actual qpos/qvel, not new dynamics; compare max force/moment/energy discrepancy under same fixed numerical tolerance, explicitly not independent solver or biological replication.
no_changes: All original outputbytes,partialstatus and original solver gates remain immutable. Tolerance reproduction is not a new convergence PASS.
